payload.text: ST0008 rule (B), from vc for hv: revert D6 (molt.rb links bin/molt into brew's bin again and drops the use-brew caveat; use brew links to opt/molt/libexec/bin/molt; the shadow check stays; MOLT_LOCAL_BIN may become ~/.local/bin).
